note: Campground in a meadow valley near Franklin along Cartoogechaye Creek, right off the main highway with flat access and no mountain switchbacks. Sells seasonal and monthly stays as well as nights; quiet and hands-off. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the operator's site and its Park With Us booking page: $40 (30A) / $45 (50A) nightly, full hookups to 50-amp, season Apr 1-Oct 31, laundry and free Wi-Fi; added max length 45 ft (back-in only), online booking, Passport America. Not stated: site count (50, left) or a dump station (the amenities page lists only a dumpster; derived dump left). Note trimmed of field facts.
